folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B399: desktop scout candidates and accessible workspace scope
folds.body:
The complete Oct. 30 GitHub/web scout was reviewed. Its registry/repository identities, package sizes, licence fields, releases and push dates are dated observations; UI fit/ranking, feature sets inferred from names, search snippets and not-watched talks retain their narrower evidence. Adopt candidate and design adoption labels describe proposals, not installed or selected dependencies. Unpacked bytes, minified shipped bytes, runtime execution and incremental bundle cost differ. A package name or unarchived/recent repository does not establish the proposed contract.

Preserve the actual proposed controls: stable row identity/selection while lists refresh; actor-known command/recipe/codex results; navigation through the incumbent route/back stack; disposed tooltips; layout restoration without a second state owner; deterministic diagnostic diffs; and a seeded NPC decision still admitted by the real command gate. A graph layout cannot remove all crossings for arbitrary topology, and graph node counts/layout must not leak unknown content. UR76–UR82 cited by the scout remain proposals, not standing authority. Its old model/effort, session routing and waiting instructions are historical rather than present delegation.

Focus trapping belongs to the selected modal dialog. Expanded nonmodal panels retain workspace navigation rather than trapping the whole multi-panel UI. Layout serialization is not gameplay persistence; mounting a library does not establish its keyboard/accessibility behavior. Keep the specific source/distribution notice question when an adoption is chosen, without turning old registry metadata into a present legal conclusion or imposing a blanket ban from a licence label. Current AD39, desktop targets, UI owners and selected lifecycle/knowledge contract govern. No dependency, UI renderer, native feature, schema, runtime benchmark or external fetch is delivered here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B399: actual method-to-use chain and conditional roadmap alternatives
folds.body:
The full Oct. 11 technology/knowledge audit retains F2–F6 at their original IDs. Recipe visibility/unlock, learned understanding, practiced execution, a stamped measurement, available tools, body/source and actual installed result remain different contracts. Its inspected base craft formula did not directly read general intelligence; that is a selected historical source observation, not absence of every stat consumer. A particular crop/drain reader or workshop kit does not demonstrate a general instrument, machine, adoption or arbitrary assembly engine. Source-era restrictions govern book examples; a broad scientific-tool idea does not automatically admit sequel mechanisms.

The capability and subtle-detail tables are optional authoring questions, not six player bars, universal fidelity decay, guaranteed failure progress, forced calibration or a new research currency. An extraordinary maker can remove a bottleneck outright. A hired maker, operator, designer and funder have distinct contributions; owning a device does not establish the ability to reproduce it. NASA readiness and NIST fitness-for-purpose analogies remain evidence-depth-limited inspiration, not compulsory player levels or current clinical/scientific certification. Precision-to-water remains a proposed connected consumer, not a newly selected Frontier build.

All eleven paired roadmaps were read through their full 22 graphs, native boundaries, people/access, world reactions, intermediate returns and fictional budgets. Literal recomputation matches every printed D/W/N. D measures graph-edge depth and W shortest-distance structural breadth across alternatives; neither is elapsed time, concurrent labor, scientific difficulty or stock feasibility. Shared capabilities do not duplicate shared consumables. Terminal leaves mark the authoring horizon, not owned or known means. Making, commissioning and obtaining remain distinct intents.

Retain target identity when comparing methods: cleaning is not necessarily literal soap; ordinary healing is not necessarily an antibiotic; a qi motor is not a steam engine; messaging talismans are not a wired telegraph. Coarse measurement may serve one task without establishing finer precision. A published record does not create mastery/faculty or reveal unknown text. A clinic, communication endpoint or press changes its actual receiver only through supported delivery and operation. Reed Basin is an original hypothetical, not a source-qualified book world. All project credit/cycle values are illustrative game values, and abstract hazardous-project nodes remain nontechnical fiction.

Already usable/unlocked means can collapse a planning branch without forcing repeated research. Actual stock, owned tools, lender access, receivers, service terms and clocks still govern admitted work. Partial outputs can remain useful, and supported exceptional means can replace institutional dependencies without inventing a balance tax. A reusable AND/OR display is not a scheduler, executable command or universal planner. Current AD51 permits the first useful seam, AD52 supports meaningful compression and long pursuits, current compatibility replaces old blanket retention requirements, and human review remains optional under AD42. No research wave, new stats, device, treatment, clock or native route is selected.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B399: evidence labels and historical session routing
folds.body:
Every table and ranked candidate was reviewed. VERIFIED describes the recorded Oct. 30 registry/API/raw-file observations, not every feature asserted in an INFERRED fit column. The APG document, several READMEs, talks and linked game content were not read in that pass. Preserve those limitations. A keyword search with no results does not establish that no suitable tool exists; package age does not by itself prove stale behavior or incompatibility. The ranking is a dated proposal under AD32.

The modal-focus done check now distinguishes actual dialogs from expanded nonmodal workspace views. UR76–UR82 remain proposed despite their use in the Serves column. The local session identifiers at the end are retained as historical identifiers rather than nonexistent heading links or evidence of live writers. Current ownership must be recovered for any separately selected slice. No tools, dependencies, UI behavior or current package facts were newly verified by reading this report.
